test_title: SSC CHSL 2025 Tier-1 (Held On: 18 Nov, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Fill in the blank with the most appropriate verb:

She _____________ her position on the matter only after repeated questioning by the press.
solution:
The correct answer is '**clarified**'. 
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 
__ 
 
• The verb "**clarified**" is the past tense of the verb "**clarify**" and is used to describe an action that has already been completed. 
 
• The sentence indicates that the action (clarifying her position) occurred after repeated questioning, which implies a completed action in the past. 
 
• Options **1, 3**, and **4** are incorrect in this context because they do not align with the past tense requirement of the sentence. 
 
Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2**. 
 
**Complete Sentence:** *"She **clarified**__ her position on the matter only after repeated questioning by the press."* 
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** 
 
 
• **Option 1: "reiterates"** is incorrect because it is in the present tense, while the sentence requires a past tense verb. 
 
• **Option 3: "deflects"** is incorrect because it implies avoiding the topic rather than addressing it directly. 
 
• **Option 4: "assumes"** is incorrect because it does not fit the context of explaining one’s position after being questioned.
